items.summary: Financial recommendation: retain the three revalidations only as capacity-gated, no-spend work. Do not claim revenue, contribution margin, ROI, causal lift, cost-to-learn, or forecasted upside. Amazon’s 2026-09-21 window reports 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission; all commission is in aggregate tracking_id other, so site-attributed income is $0 and revenue claims are unsupported. AI usage on 2026-10-01 totals $22.1593508 across only 17 instrumented sites versus 38 expected, so fleet AI spend and AI cost-to-learn are incomplete. Contribution margin and budget exposure are not calculable because direct infrastructure, domains, labor/implementation time, monthly budgets, fixed costs, and site-level revenue allocation are unavailable. Minimum measurement is registered tracking IDs mapped to site/content, direct cost by site and change, implementation effort/time, and complete AI-cost coverage. Proceed only after CTO reconciles capacity by 2026-10-01T18:00Z and each change has an explicit baseline, threshold, rollback, and measurement window.
